scripts.dev: npm run env:sync && cd frontend && npm install --silent && node ../scripts/dev.js
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && cd frontend && npm run typecheck
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install --silent && node build.js
scripts.start:bridge: npm run env:sync && npm run build:bridge && node dist/mqtt_bridge.js
scripts.build:standalone: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:server
scripts.build: npm run env:sync && npm run build:workers && npm run build:bridge && npm run build:frontend
scripts.deploy:ingest: npm run env:sync && npm run build:workers && cd workers/ingest && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:dashboard: npm run env:sync && npm run build && cd workers/dashboard && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy: npm run env:sync && npm run build && cd workers/ingest && wrangler deploy && cd ../dashboard && wrangler deploy
scripts.db:init: cd workers/ingest && wrangler d1 execute jkbms-db --remote --file=../../schema.sql
